Command.Statement: with member measures.StaticCount as count([Product].[Product Subcategory].Members) member measures.WithExisting as count(Existing [Product].[Product Subcategory].Members) member measures.WithExists as count(Exists([Product].[Product Subcategory].Members, [Product].CurrentMember)) select {measures.StaticCount, measures.WithExisting, measures.WithExists} on 0, [Product].[Product Family].Members on 1 from [ZFMSALES]
